ceu: ✦ The opposition between Venus and Uranus

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and money. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between routine and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between romance and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between family and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between money and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your image and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1825607339000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your career and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.
